EditorMetadata.Comment: HullDownAttackRun — one tank's run in the hill attack (CE-2230, hill-attack DESIGN §0): the vehicle exposure cycle in its LANE mode. From the baseline slot out along the lane, stop the first tick it SEES its target (hull-down), ONE round, reverse back into the slot, done (R-2022). The commander's payload is written into Params.fight by HillAttackTankNodes.ResolveHullDownAttackRun.
